operatorApproval.notes: AUDIT/suite-termination-blocker-20261105.txt reported two integration files that never settled. Reproduced at 4ffa82f3: GitRepo.commonDir() returned /private/private/var/folders/.../<repo>/.git, a path that does not exist, while a plain `git -C <repo> rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir` in the same process returned the right one; mkdir under the doubled path ENOENTs and withWorktreeSection reads ENOENT as lock contention, so mission-interrupt-pause.test.ts had to be killed at 240 s (see logs/05, logs/06). The upstream ROOT cause - Pi's state dir kept unresolved while repositories are discovered through realpathSync - is already fixed on main by 61394da7 (one canonical path for the state dir and the temp root, #582): at 45d42acb the doubled prefix no longer reproduces and both blocker files pass unaided (logs/07). What this unit adds is the consumer-side half of the contract, which #582 does not provide: commonDir() had no way to notice an answer that names nothing, so any future regression of that canonicalization surfaces as a ten-minute poll per attempt rather than an error. resolveCommonDir returns an existing answer untouched (it is usually the shadow common dir, which only git knows), repairs a missing one from discoverRepo - which also recovers the SHARED common directory for a linked worktree - and names the impossible path when neither resolves; only ENOENT/ENOTDIR count as absent, EACCES/ESTALE/EIO propagate. Measured: new unit 5/5; the five git unit files in the touched area 26/26 (logs/02); A/B at 4ffa82f3 24/40 -> 39/45 on test/unit/git-*.test.ts with 10 fixed and 0 regressions (logs/09); blocker files at the tip 12/12 and 6/6 (logs/08). Deviation recorded: the unit measures 158 changed lines across 1 production + 1 test file, over the isolated-change ceiling of 100; the guard is 44 lines and its regression unit 114, and splitting the test from the behaviour it pins would leave the contract unpinned.
